caseNameFull: Buck, President of the American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers v. Case, State Treasurer of Washington
attorneys: Messrs. Thomas G. Haight, Louis D. Frohlich, and Herman Finkelstein for appellants. Messrs. Smith Troy and John E. Belcher for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of appellee Lockhart to reinstate this case on the calendar is denied. On consideration of the stipulation of counsel the appeal is dismissed without costs. Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this case.
